name: apply
description: Executes impact report: creates and obsoletes beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment, parent hierarchy, lineage tracking, and priority propagation. Tags with proposal, saves new merkle snapshot, maintains mapping records.

requirements.title: Create beads
requirements.description: Create beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment from spec node type (module→epic, component→feature, test_section→task), parent hierarchy via --parent, lineage via --deps blocks:<old-bead-id>, and priority via --priority derived from project requirements.

requirements.title: Obsolete beads
requirements.description: Obsolete existing beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with spex:obsolete label and commit:<HEAD> label. The commit label stamps the last commit where the bead's spec was valid. Used for both modified and removed spec nodes.

requirements.title: Tag with proposal
requirements.description: All affected beads (created, obsoleted) are tagged with the proposal reference that triggered the change.

requirements.title: Save snapshot
requirements.description: After applying all bead actions, save the new merkle snapshot to mark the current state as baseline.

requirements.title: Idempotent apply
requirements.description: Applying the same impact report twice produces no additional changes. Already-created beads are not duplicated, already-obsoleted beads are not re-obsoleted.

requirements.title: Maintain mapping records
requirements.description: After bead operations, write/update/remove mapping records in .bead-map.json. For modified nodes: update existing record with new bead_id and spec_hash. For removed nodes: delete record. For added nodes: insert new record. Set bead label to spex:<record-id>.

requirements.title: Deterministic type, hierarchy, and lineage
requirements.description: Bead type is a pure function of spec node type (module→epic, component→feature, test_section→task). Component beads get --parent <module-epic-bead-id>. Test beads get --parent <component-feature-bead-id>. Creation order: epics first, then features, then tasks. Modified nodes: obsolete old bead, create new bead with --deps blocks:<old-bead-id>.

requirements.title: Priority propagation
requirements.description: Derive bead priority from project requirements via the chain: component.implements[] → module requirement.preq_id → project requirement.priority. Lowest priority number (highest urgency) wins. Passed via --priority on bead CLI create.

components.name: BeadCreator
components.description: Creates new beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with deterministic type assignment from spec node type table, --parent for hierarchy, --deps blocks:<old-bead-id> for lineage, and --priority from project requirement chain. After creation, creates or updates the mapping record in .bead-map.json and sets the bead label to spex:<record-id>.

components.name: BeadCloser
components.description: Obsoletes beads via bead CLI (br or bd) with spex:obsolete label and commit:<HEAD> label. Uniform path for both modified and removed spec nodes. For removed nodes, deletes the corresponding mapping record from .bead-map.json.

components.name: ProposalTagger
components.description: Tags all affected beads with the proposal reference that triggered the changes.

components.name: SnapshotSaver
components.description: Saves the new merkle snapshot after all bead actions are complete.

components.name: ApplyCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex apply. Reads impact report, enforces creation ordering (epics → features → tasks), wires BeadCreator, BeadCloser, ProposalTagger, SnapshotSaver, executes all bead actions.

data_flows.name: Apply flow
data_flows.description: Impact report is read. Bead actions execute in type order: obsoletes first (for modified/removed nodes), then creates in hierarchy order (epics → features → tasks). All are tagged with the proposal. New snapshot saved.
